pins.title: Check Monthly Does Not Mean Replace Every Month
heading: Check it.
Then decide.
pins.description: Start a repeatable HVAC filter routine. Check monthly, especially during heavy use, and follow the equipment and filter instructions for cleaning or replacement. Use the free six-point record to keep the details together.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: Check it. Then decide. Inspect monthly; Follow the filter instructions; Record the action and date.

heading: One filter.
Six useful notes.
pins.description: Copy the free six-point filter record into a private note: system, correct filter, compatible rating, instructions, actual action and next check. No signup or purchase is required.

pins.title: A Higher MERV Rating Is Not a Fit Guarantee
heading: A rating is not
a fit guarantee.
lines: Do not choose by rating alone
pins.description: Before changing filter efficiency, confirm what your HVAC system can accommodate. The guide links EPA guidance and explains what to document without guessing from the old filter.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: A rating is not a fit guarantee. Check equipment compatibility; Use the manual or technician; Do not choose by rating alone.

pins.title: Last Checked or Last Replaced? Keep Both Filter Dates
heading: Checked today?
Say what changed.
pins.description: A date alone does not tell the next person whether the filter was inspected, cleaned as instructed, or replaced. Keep the action with the date using the free filter-record prompts.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: Checked today? Say what changed. Inspection is one action; Replacement is another; Record the next check too.

pins.title: A Useful HVAC Filter Note for a New Homeowner
heading: New home.
Know the filter.
pins.description: Share a useful free filter-record link in a homeowner welcome note or resource list. Let the household confirm its own equipment details and keep completed records private.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: New home. Know the filter. Confirm each filter location; Keep the instruction reference; Make one record per system.
